contact.waMessage: Hi Parmarpro, I'd like a free preview for my clinic. Here's our Google Maps link:

packages.name: Launch
packages.blurb: Everything in your preview, switched on in a week.
items: Your new website live on your own domain (domain at cost)
Google profile fixed: all 10 checklist points
WhatsApp Business set up with booking quick replies
Review QR card for your reception desk

packages.name: Grow
packages.blurb: We run the systems every week, so you can focus on patients. Month-to-month.
items: Review requests sent to your patients after their visits
A drafted reply for every new review
Weekly Google posts and fresh photos
Appointment reminders and a monthly recall campaign

offer.guarantee: your website goes live within 7 days of your go-ahead, or Launch is free. Grow is month-to-month — stop any time with one message.

faq.a: Because showing beats telling. We'd rather spend a few hours building something real for your clinic than ask you for a meeting. If it's good, some clinics ask us to run it. If it isn't useful, it cost you nothing.
No. It's on a private link that search engines are told not to index, and it's clearly marked as a concept by Parmarpro, not your official site. Ask and we'll remove it within 24 hours.

faq.q: Can I just use the plan myself?
faq.a: Yes. The scripts, the checklist and the website design are yours to use. If you'd rather do it in-house, we're glad it helped.
Yes. The domain is registered in your clinic's name and the site is yours. If you ever stop working with us, you keep it.

faq.q: What do you need from me?
faq.a: A 15-minute call, any photos or logo you have, and manager access to your Google Business Profile — added from your own account. We never ask for passwords.

faq.q: Do you work with other kinds of businesses?
faq.a: Right now we focus only on dental clinics. Doing one thing well is the point.
